note:
DIN 1460-2:2011-10, Tabelle 1, language row 14 (Eskimo); held source
interscript-private-references/din/din-1460-2.pdf. Rows are the language
column's printed cells, taken from the durable mechanical extraction
tools/din1460-2-table.json (x-anchored text-layer extraction, maps PR
#242 provenance), re-verified cell-by-cell against the printed grid
rectangles (pymupdf find_tables re-extraction, 2026-11-26) and
end-to-end through the ts runtime (interscript-ts dist). Positions
referenced by the table's own position numbers.
Cell notes: ң (position 47) — printed cell "ņ" (n + combining cedilla,
the DIN uvular/nasal series); the #242 artifact flattened it to 'n', the
row is transcribed as printed. This is the maps#298 cedilla family (cf.
din-ab 37, din-az 38, din-ba 39/47, fixed there; this map's instance is
a finding below). | к̢ (position 37) — printed cell "ķ" (k + combining
cedilla); the #242 artifact flattened it to 'k', transcribed as printed
(same #298 cedilla family). | ʼ (position 98) — printed cell "('')",
transcribed paren-stripped.
Supplementary columns: the #242 extraction stops at position 90; the
printed grid's columns 91-99 for this language are transcribed here from
the grid (page 22): ю → ju, я → ja, ʼ → '. Position 96's header is
printed Cyrillic я; the text layer stores Latin 'ja' (the
lookalike-glyph defect documented in the odni batch-1 artifacts).
Findings (map-vs-source; rows present in this artifact but EXCLUDED from
the generated tests, never forced green; record for the maps-fix
pipeline): к̢ (position 37): printed 'ķ', map outputs 'k' | ң (position
47): printed 'ņ', map outputs 'n' | ю (position 95): printed 'ju', map
outputs 'ю' | я (position 96): printed 'ja', map outputs 'я' | ʼ
(position 98): printed "'", map outputs 'ʼ'
Generated tests cover the 34 passing rows of 39; the map's own hand
tests are retained (duplicated froms are the batch-2 convention).
